# Self-test MIDI for `learn --replay`. One block per capture step, in order:
# baseline, then each step the script answers, then the final sweep.
# block 0: baseline (hands off) - a stray stream that must be ignored later
B0 6F 01
B0 6F 01
---
# block 1: deckA.play, first attempt (the script answers r = redo)
90 11 7F
---
# block 2: deckA.play again: press + release, plus background noise
90 11 7F
B0 6F 01
90 11 00
---
# block 3: deckA.pitchFader: 14-bit CC 04 (MSB) + CC 24 (LSB), min to max
B0 04 00 B0 24 00
B0 04 20 B0 24 10
B0 04 40 B0 24 20
B0 04 60 B0 24 30
B0 04 7F B0 24 7F
---
# block 4: deckA.platterRotation: CC 00 stream + pitch bend, forward then back
B0 00 01 E0 00 40
B0 00 02 E0 10 40
B0 00 03 E0 20 40
B0 00 02 E0 10 40
B0 00 01 E0 00 40
---
# block 5: deckA.bleepReverse - nothing (the script skips it)
---
# block 6: browse.scrollKnob: relative encoder, two's complement
B0 50 01 B0 50 01 B0 50 01 B0 50 7F B0 50 7F
---
# block 7: final sweep: a known key plus one nobody owns

B0 77 40
